title: API Authentication and Token Usage
content: All requests to the CloudDash REST API must be authenticated. We support authentication using API tokens passed via HTTP headers. Step 1: Generate an API token in Settings → Developer Settings. Step 2: Include the token in your HTTP requests using the Authorization header formatted as 'Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>'. API tokens have full read/write access to your metrics and alert rules, so keep them secure. Do not hardcode tokens in client-side code. If a token is compromised, revoke it immediately from the Developer Settings dashboard and generate a new one. We support up to 5 active API tokens per user account for separate scripting workflows.
